model_package_name: CardioVanta production package 1.0.0 (Phase5-Final): sigmoid-calibrated 13-feature Logistic Regression

evidence: Trained by src/experiment/phase5.py on the raw target column of data/raw/heart.csv, which is inverted relative to UCI num (target 1 = num == 0; target 0 = num > 0): reports/phase17_multicenter_validation.md section 3; src/cardiovanta/data/external_loader.py parse_cleveland_dev_cohort.
Recorded in the clinical contract: cardiovanta_ml/contracts/feature_schema.v2.json model_label_mappings (cardiovanta-lr13 1.0.0, disease_present_label 0, interim_legacy).

calibration.cv: 5 StratifiedGroupKFold splits on duplicate-row groups of the 242 development rows
calibration.base_estimator: Pipeline(ColumnTransformer[StandardScaler(5 continuous), passthrough(3 binary), OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore', 5 categorical)] -> LogisticRegression(C=0.1, class_weight='balanced', solver='lbfgs', random_state=42))
calibration.probability_semantics: predict_proba[:, index of label 0] = P(disease present) = 1 - P(label 1); exact for a binary sigmoid-calibrated classifier

explanation.description: Separate uncalibrated LogisticRegression (same preprocessing and hyperparameters) fitted on the same 242 development rows by src/experiment/phase5.py. It explains its own log-odds exactly; it is not the calibrated ensemble and does not decompose the reported probability.

provenance.registered: 2026-10-31 (R2). Artifacts registered in place at artifacts/model/ without modification.
